title: Lids are flimsy and don't stay on
text: Lids are flimsy and don't stay on. If you're just looking for a desert cup and spoons this works but if you need to put the lids on (and I needed the lids on) forget it. The lids were so flimsy they were stuck together and ripped some trying to separate them. Then they didn't latch on and just fell off
